title: Controls, forms & search

resolvedFindings.change: Combobox listbox options now use tabIndex=-1 so keyboard focus remains on the combobox while aria-activedescendant controls the active option.
Clearing search returns focus to the search input after the clear button unmounts.
Search category chips expose aria-pressed and result count changes are announced politely.
Search results are positioned from the bottom of the search card with top-full instead of a fixed pixel offset, reducing narrow-width heading-wrap risk.
Contact, social, official-city and related action links use the 44px interaction-height baseline.
Get Involved and civic report/contribution/observation forms expose aria-busy, announce submitting state, use alert semantics for errors, and keep status-result actions touch sized.
Geolocation warnings and civic-registry search result counts are announced, and selectable place cards expose aria-pressed.
Government Offices scope chips expose aria-pressed, 44px targets and a polite result-count status.
City Monitor search/select controls use the 44px baseline, result counts are announced, and place-context links are touch sized.
Public Records select/checkbox filters and clear action use the 44px baseline and matching-source count is announced.
Participation now distinguishes loading, feed failure and a genuinely empty community-input feed.
Services category loading now distinguishes a request failure from an empty category.

preservedStrengths: ServiceSearch keeps combobox/listbox/option semantics and arrow-key navigation.
Shared .form-field inputs/selects/textareas remain at least 44px high.
Form fields continue to use explicit wrapping labels.
Civic form honeypot fields remain removed from the Tab order.
Full-card selection controls remain large touch targets.

bounded.reason: Table/list toggles and dense table behavior belong to the complex-component pass.
Photo carousel dots, attribution and motion behavior belong to the complex-component pass.
Popup clipping, virtual keyboard behavior, real zoom/reflow and computed contrast require a current browser build.
Source semantics do not replace manual screen-reader and keyboard sampling.

staticRules.comboboxFocusModel: input retains DOM focus; listbox options use aria-activedescendant and tabIndex=-1
staticRules.selectionState: toggle/filter buttons expose aria-pressed where they represent persistent selection
staticRules.asyncState: loading/submitting uses role=status or equivalent; actionable failures use role=alert
staticRules.resultCounts: dynamic filtered/search result counts use polite status announcements when helpful
